topic: My first visit to the gym
passage: Last month, I decided to join a gym near my home. Although I had wanted to exercise for a long time, I had always found an excuse to stay at home. One Saturday morning, I walked into the gym and signed up for a one-month pass. A young coach welcomed me and showed me around the hall. He explained that I should warm up for ten minutes before I worked out, and cool down slowly after I finished. First, I tried out the running machine and walked for fifteen minutes. Then the coach showed me how to lift light weights and use the rowing machine. My arms felt tired after only a few minutes, but I kept going because the coach counted loudly and cheered me on. After the class, I picked up a bottle of water and sat down on a bench. I looked around and saw many people who worked out every day. Some lifted heavy weights, and others stretched quietly in a corner. When I left the gym, my legs felt weak, but my heart felt light. I decided to come back three times a week, because a strong body helps me work and sleep better.
